title: Rhoifolin Attenuates DSS-Induced Colitis in Mice by Modulating Gut Microbiota and Restoring Th17/Treg Balance.
authors: Xu, Hao; Wang, Ze-Hui; Zhong, Sheng-Lan; Chen, Tian; Liu, Su-Zhi; Zhang, Song-Lin; Xie, Xiao-Xuan; Liu, Te; Yang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Rhoifolin通过调节肠道菌群和Th17/Treg平衡缓解小鼠结肠炎，其中仅含分子对接分析ROF与转录因子RORγt和FOXP3的结合，但核心是炎症疾病机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rhoifolin (ROF), a flavonoid compound isolated from citrus plants, has been shown in modern research to possess a range of important biological activities, including anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor properties. METHODS: In this study, we induced ulcerative colitis (UC) in mice using dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) and treated them with ROF during the therapeutic phase. RESULTS: The results showed that ROF significantly alleviated the weight loss, colon shortening, and histopathological damage in the colon tissues of the mice, while also improving intestinal barrier function by restoring the expression of ZO-1 and E-cadherin. 16S rDNA sequencing analysis indicated that ROF treatment significantly altered the diversity and composition of the gut microbiota, increasing the relative abundance of Bacteroidetes, and Lactobacillus. Flow cytometry analysis revealed that ROF significantly reduced the proportion of Th17 cells in peripheral blood while increasing the proportion of Treg cells. Molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ROF could effectively bind to the Th17 cell transcription factor RORgammat and the Treg cell transcription factor FOXP3, suggesting a potential regulatory effect. Further transcriptomic analysis revealed that ROF downregulated the expression of genes associated with the IL-17 signaling pathway, including IL-17A, TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, CXCL10, and CXCL5, further supporting its anti-inflammatory mechanism by inhibiting the IL-17 pathway. DISCUSSION: In conclusion, we provides the first evidence that ROF alleviates DSS-induced colonic inflammation by modulating gut microbiota diversity, restoring the Th17/Treg cell balance, and inhibiting the IL-17 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 引言：Rhoifolin (ROF)，一种从柑橘类植物中分离出的黄酮类化合物，现代研究已表明其具有一系列重要的生物活性，包括抗炎和抗肿瘤特性。方法：在本研究中，我们使用葡聚糖硫酸钠 (DSS) 诱导小鼠溃疡性结肠炎 (UC)，并在治疗阶段给予ROF处理。结果：结果显示，ROF显著减轻了小鼠的体重下降、结肠缩短及结肠组织的组织病理学损伤，同时通过恢复ZO-1和E-cadherin的表达改善了肠道屏障功能。16S rDNA测序分析表明，ROF处理显著改变了肠道微生物群的多样性和组成，增加了拟杆菌门 (Bacteroidetes) 和乳酸杆菌属 (Lactobacillus) 的相对丰度。流式细胞术分析显示，ROF显著降低了外周血中Th17细胞的比例，同时增加了Treg细胞的比例。分子对接分析表明，ROF能有效结合Th17细胞转录因子RORgammat和Treg细胞转录因子FOXP3，提示其具有潜在调节作用。进一步的转录组学分析揭示，ROF下调了与IL-17信号通路相关基因的表达，包括IL-17A、TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB、CXCL10和CXCL5，进一步支持其通过抑制IL-17通路发挥抗炎机制。讨论：总之，我们首次提供证据表明，ROF通过调节肠道微生物群多样性、恢复Th17/Treg细胞平衡及抑制IL-17信号通路，缓解DSS诱导的结肠炎症。
